About this item

  • Premium Moonstone Finish: Refined foldable design with a premium Moonstone finish that opens into a large, immersive inner display for multitasking and entertainment
  • Advanced Performance: Powered by the Tensor G5 chip, paired with 16 GB RAM and 256 GB storage for smooth, fast, and efficient performance
  • Dual-Display Setup: Features a bright 6.4-inch OLED cover screen and a spacious 8-inch vibrant inner Super Actua Flex OLED display with peak brightness up to 3000 nits
  • Versatile Triple-Camera System: Equipped with a 48 MP main lens, ultra-wide lens, and 5× telephoto lens for sharp, detailed, and vibrant photos with excellent zoom clarity
  • Long-Lasting Battery: 5,015 mAh battery with fast wired charging, magnetic Qi2 wireless charging, and an improved hinge design for durability and comfort
  • Durability and Protection: IP68 rating provides dust and water resistance, ensuring your device stays protected in various conditions
  • Enhanced Multitasking: Large inner display enables seamless multitasking, allowing you to run multiple apps simultaneously for improved productivity

Product description

The Pixel 10 Pro Fold brings together premium craftsmanship and cutting-edge tech in a beautifully foldable phone. With a shimmering Moonstone finish, 256 GB of storage and 16 GB of RAM powering the efficient new Tensor G5 chip, this device blends speed and elegance effortlessly. The dual-display setup is a standout — a bright 6.4-inch OLED cover display for quick tasks, and a large 8-inch “Super Actua Flex” inner OLED display for immersive browsing, multitasking or media viewing, both capable of peak brightness up to 3000 nits. Its triple-camera system (including a 48 MP main lens, ultra-wide and 5× telephoto lenses) captures detailed, vibrant photos and lets you zoom in with clarity — ideal for both everyday shots and creative photography. A 5,015 mAh battery keeps you powered through the day, with fast wired charging and magnetic Qi2 wireless charging for convenience. Add in premium touches like dust/water resistance (IP68), slick materials and a refined hinge design, and the Pixel 10 Pro Fold feels like Google’s vision of a truly versatile, premium smartphone — blending portability, performance, and elegance in one. If you like — I can also write a similar description tailored for camera / photography lovers or for productivity / power users.

    Extremely disappointing after-sales experience. My Google Pixel phone was under warranty, and I was initially informed it would be replaced at zero cost after inspection. Later, the service team denied replacement by blaming “hinge damage” without providing any inspection report or evidence.

    After making me wait over one month with repeated assurances, they gave the same response and demanded ₹66,000 for replacement. As an “apology” for the delay, they offered ₹2,000 Google credit.

    54+ emails, hours of calls, and still no fair resolution. Poor service, lack of transparency, and complete disregard for consumer rights. Buyers should be aware of the after-sales support experience before purchasing.
